connector.name: MCP Abap Adt by fr0ster
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for SAP ABAP ADT: repository analysis and CRUD for RAP and classic ABAP
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package core. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the fr0ster account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SAP_URL
env.description: Base URL of the ABAP system (e.g. https://my-system.example.com or a BTP ABAP service URL). Required to connect; without it the server starts in tool-inspection-only mode.

env.name: SAP_AUTH_TYPE
env.description: Authentication method: 'xsuaa' for JWT/OAuth2 (BTP ABAP Cloud) or 'basic' for username/password (on-prem).

env.name: SAP_SYSTEM_TYPE
env.description: System type, controls which tools are available (e.g. Programs are onprem-only).

env.name: SAP_CLIENT
env.description: ABAP client/mandant number (e.g. 100). Optional for BTP ABAP Cloud.

env.name: SAP_JWT_TOKEN
env.description: JWT bearer token for SAP_AUTH_TYPE=xsuaa. Provide this (or the SAP_UAA_* refresh-token set) for JWT auth.

env.name: SAP_MASTER_SYSTEM
env.description: System context for on-prem create/update operations (e.g. DEV).

env.name: SAP_RESPONSIBLE
env.description: Responsible user for on-prem create/update operations.
